# iaas_microvm_catalog (Data Source)

Reads the unified MicroVM placement catalog, including locations, plans, ready images, network choices, and limits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iaas_microvm_catalog" "current" {}

output "microvm_locations" {
  value = data.iaas_microvm_catalog.current.locations
}

# Only the plans whose disk holds a kit's image.
data "iaas_microvm_catalog" "for_kit" {
  image_id = data.iaas_microvm_catalog.current.images[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `image_id` (String) A kit visible to the account. When set, each location lists only the plans whose disk holds that kit's image (see `required_disk_gib` on the kit); a kit whose size is unknown excludes no plan. Leave unset for every plan.
- `image_version_id` (String) A version of `image_id` to size the plans against; defaults to the kit's current version. Requires `image_id`.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))
- `limits` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `locations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
- `security_groups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--security_groups))
- `vpc_subnets` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc_subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Launcher category of the kit.
- `default_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Suggested sandbox lifetime in seconds.
- `default_plan_vcpu` (Number) Suggested vCPU count for the default plan.
- `exposed_ports` (List of Number)
- `icon` (String) Launcher icon key.
- `id` (String)
- `is_base` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `required_disk_gib` (Number) Disk in GiB the kit's image needs; null when unknown; a figure of 2 or less excludes no plan, as the node launches such images on any plan. A sandbox on a plan with less disk is refused with reason plan_disk_too_small.
- `sort_order` (Number) Launcher sort order.
- `status` (String)
- `suggested_secrets` (Attributes List) Secrets the kit suggests setting at launch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images--suggested_secrets))
- `tagline` (String) Short launcher tagline.

<a id="nestedatt--images--suggested_secrets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images.suggested_secrets`

Read-Only:

- `help_url` (String)
- `icon` (String) Icon key of the row. Null when the kit does not set it.
- `label` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `placeholder` (String) Placeholder text of the launcher field. Null when the kit does not set it.
- `provider` (String) Provider key the secret belongs to (for example anthropic). Null when the kit does not set it.
- `role` (String) provider (feeds the secrets token) or repo (the repo access line). Null on a kit published before roles existed.
